items.title: BAPOConnect
items.summary: BAPOConnect is the official tri-annual magazine of the British Association of Prosthetics and Orthotics (BAPO), created exclusively for our members. Each edition serves as a dynamic platform for knowledge sharing, professional dialogue, and sector-wide updates across the field of prosthetics and orthotics.
